research_notes: Reviewed official occupations and historical Handbook, first speech, government biography, contemporary business register, winery site, REST annual report and trustee filing, plus reliable secondary first-full-time-job and label-transfer evidence.

Complete initial occupation list preserved, including early postal, council and hospitality work. Those unresolved employers cannot be assigned public/private totals from job labels. Uncle-operated kiosk is distinguished from public park.

Follow-up: kiosk legal/payroll identity and dates/hours; postal employer; council and waiter employers and short intervals; union hours/leave and federal presidency; REST appointment date and historical pay; vineyard business work hours, breaks and ownership/label transition.

Farrell Wines label/business-name continuity differs from official 2014–2016 occupation entry. ABN activation, GST dates and trading-name changes are not evidence of employment start/end or full-time status.
